analysis_kind: descriptive offline comparison; no acceptance verdict
method: Decimal parsed fields; relative=|candidate-baseline|/|baseline| only when baseline != 0; baseline-zero cases reported with no denominator floor

mapping.occupations: Fe_out.nml/Fe_scf.nml ql(1,:,spin), entries s,p,d in array order
mapping.spin_axis: potential%mom is normalized/reference spin direction; not sphere-spin magnitude
mapping.orbital_moment: potential%lmom is non-normalized orbital angular-momentum vector
mapping.sphere_spin: radial_ground_state_Fe_1.dat header reported_moment_xyz_muB; source self.f90 copies potential%mom0 to magmom, and bands.f90 sets mom0=(mx,my,mz)
